[ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples include:

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Embracing flexibility: Being open to change and having the capacity to pivot from one strategy to another.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Leveraging data and analytics: Gathering and analyzing data for informed decisions for both short-term tactics and long-term strategies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Building a company culture of innovation: Encouraging team members to think outside the box and share new ideas.
